overview: 针对机器人领路任务，现有方法在理解追随者与执行路线之间存在耦合问题。作者提出了LeadVLA，这是一种结构化的多模态策略，通过将路线保留为显式参考路径，同时学习路线进展速度和针对追随者及场景的局部调整余量。此外，作者构建了LeadInfra仿真环境与LeadBench基准测试集。实验表明，LeadVLA在基准测试中展现出更高的任务成功率，并能实现零样本的现实世界迁移。

highlights.text: LeadVLA采用显式路径参考结合学习速度控制与局部适应余量的结构，实现了机器人对追随者的有效引导。
highlights.evidence: We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation.

highlights.text: 该方法在LeadBench测试中表现优于其他策略，且无需微调即可成功迁移至现实环境。
highlights.evidence: LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning.
